assumptions: Genuine player0 plus at most eight map-THING MT_TROOP/MT_POSSESSED/MT_SHOTGUY/MT_CHAINGUY/MT_SERGEANT and at most 16 map-THING pickups in six polygon rooms (doorway with its D1-only variant hall, switchyard, lift at three lift ceilings, floors, dense, and pit, whose turbo target has its only neighbour floor below -500) built by the M3h6 node builder with declared sector heights and tags and line specials 1, 63, 109, 88, 36, 38 and 11 (two-sided 48 is not built: decision N1 keeps it rejected); no Rust expected observations.

Every compiled body, observer and controlled input of M3h2/M3h5/M3h6/M3h7 is reused unchanged. Added genuine bodies: M_ClearBox, M_AddToBox (m_bbox.c); twoSided, getSide, getSector, P_FindLowestFloorSurrounding, P_FindHighestFloorSurrounding, P_FindNextHighestFloor, P_FindLowestCeilingSurrounding, P_FindHighestCeilingSurrounding, P_FindSectorFromLineTag, P_CrossSpecialLine (p_spec.c); P_ThingHeightClip, PIT_ChangeSector, P_ChangeSector, PTR_UseTraverse, P_UseLines (p_map.c); T_MovePlane, T_MoveFloor, EV_DoFloor (p_floor.c); T_VerticalDoor, EV_DoDoor, EV_VerticalDoor (p_doors.c); T_PlatRaise, EV_DoPlat, P_AddActivePlat, P_RemoveActivePlat (p_plats.c); G_ExitLevel (g_game.c); P_StartButton, P_ChangeSwitchTexture, P_UseSpecialLine (p_switch.c). Bodies whose generic extraction would start at a `// name()` comment header are extracted from their definition; function_sha256 hashes that extraction. Thirteen of them are compiled as Raw_<name> under an observer wrapper with the same signature (see row_formats).

Genuine fragments: the use block of P_PlayerThink (p_user.c:322-331) runs after the weapon change and before P_MovePsprites; the BT_USE statement of P_DeathThink (p_user.c:227-228) runs for a dead player after P_MovePsprites; the soundorg and blockbox statements of P_GroupLines (p_setup.c:555-574) run at load over the bbox the genuine M_ClearBox/M_AddToBox build from every line with the sector on either side, in line order. G_PlayerReborn sets usedown = true.

Order (P_Ticker, p_tick.c:148-157; P_PlayerThink): a door opened by use is created in the player stage and steps in the same op; movers created by crossings are created inside P_RunThinkers by the crossing mobj and step later in the same pass; every new mover joins the thinker list at its tail (P_AddThinker). A removed mover keeps its list entry (TK kind 8) until the next pass unlinks it (SF).

Declared adapters: S_StartSound records its origin (SO rows for &sector->soundorg and for the address of a buttonlist soundorg field; E code 7 rows for NULL and mobj origins); every side texture is resolved at load from the names in the committed SIDEDEFS bytes through the declared synthetic texture table (TESTWALL 0, SW1COMM 1, SW2COMM 2; `-` is 0; the R_TextureNumForName stand-in), so the SW1COMM middle texture the builder writes on the front side of every 11/63 line is 1 and every other texture 0; switchlist is the declared pair {SW1COMM, SW2COMM} = {1, 2} with numswitches 1 (P_InitSwitchList stand-in); G_ExitLevel is genuine and its gameaction/secretexit are harness globals; G_DoCompleted and G_DoReborn are not executed: the case ends at the end of the op that requested them (MG rows); mover allocations (Z_Malloc PU_LEVSPEC) are zero-filled in the harness store and Z_Free quarantines a sector thinker as it quarantines a mobj (ids never reused); textureheight is a null pointer (raiseToTexture is unreachable); EV_DoCeiling, EV_CeilingCrushStop, EV_Teleport, EV_LightTurnOn, EV_StartLightStrobing, EV_TurnTagLightsOff, EV_StopPlat, EV_BuildStairs, EV_DoDonut, EV_DoLockedDoor, G_SecretExitLevel and P_ActivateInStasis abort if reached (no admitted line reaches them).

The dead player's commands keep only BT_USE (the inherited harness zeroes them); P_DeathThink's view-height, angle and damagecount statements are still not run (bounded death stage, as since M3g). Controlled inputs: BT_USE is held on every op of each use window, one extra angleturn (turn2 at turn2_at), two extra forwardmove windows, and one between-tic target assignment plus see-state entry (chase_at: P_SetMobjState(mo, mo->info->seestate) after the inherited damage and attack entry; its A_Chase runs at once, outside any tic).

spechit keeps its source size line_t* spechit[8] and PIT_CheckLine its unchecked append: the sanitizer build would report a ninth write. No room exceeds rule 6 (largest special window 8, the dense lane); the nine-line lane is written as m3h8_dense9.bin for the Rust-only SpecialCross witness and is never run in C. T_MovePlane is always called with crush false, so the PIT_ChangeSector damage and blood branch (its only P_Random draws) is unreachable.
Bounded original command/weapon stage precedes original thinkers; not complete P_Ticker/PlayerThink/DeathThink or respawn. P_RespawnSpecials (deathmatch 2 only) is not called.
All M3h1/M3h2/M3h4/M3h5/M3h6/M3h7 assumptions and adapters apply, including the strict-build retyping of attack-angle int locals; every new row only observes genuine statements.

row_formats.E: existing; E,case,op,7,actor|-1,sound now also records sfx_noway at the player and the global switch sound of P_ChangeSwitchTexture when buttonlist[0] has no origin
row_formats.HC: HC,case,op,thing,result,z before,z,floorz,ceilingz,height,numspechit: P_ThingHeightClip (its P_CheckPosition result is ignored by the source)
row_formats.LE: as M3h7: LE,case,op,kind,id when P_RunThinkers runs a sector thinker, now also kinds 5 door, 6 plat, 7 floor
row_formats.MA: MA,case,op,player,angle,x,y: P_UseLines entry; its P_PathTraverse rows (TR traverser 3, D/B/U/I/TI) carry trace stage 9
row_formats.MB: MB,case,op,slot,line,where,btexture,btimer,soundorg sector (-1 none): a buttonlist slot with a timer, line or sound origin after the op; presentation
row_formats.MC: MC,case,op,0,sector,crunch,floorheight,ceilingheight at P_ChangeSector entry; MC,case,op,1,sector,nofit,floorheight,ceilingheight at its exit
row_formats.ME: ME,case,op,fn,line,arg,thing,result,store count before,store count after: fn 1 EV_DoDoor(arg = vldoor_e), 2 EV_VerticalDoor(arg = line special; thing = user; result -1), 3 EV_DoPlat(arg = plattype_e), 4 EV_DoFloor(arg = floor_e); a mover was created when the store count grew
row_formats.MG: MG,case,op,0,gameaction,secretexit at G_ExitLevel; MG,case,op,code,playerstate at the end of the op when G_DoCompleted (code 1) or G_DoReborn (code 2) would run at the next G_Ticker: the case ends there
row_formats.MH: MH,case,op,numsectors,(floorheight,ceilingheight,specialdata) for every sector in index order after each op; heights raw 16.16, specialdata = the sector-thinker store index of sector->specialdata or -1
row_formats.MI: MI,case,op,line,frac,special,openrange (-1 when special),result: PTR_UseTraverse visited a line intercept (result 0 stops the trace)
row_formats.MK: MK,case,op,thing,line,index,inclip: PIT_CheckLine is about to store line at spechit[index] for tmthing; inclip 1 inside P_ThingHeightClip. spechit keeps its source size (8)
row_formats.ML: ML,case,op,(line,special)... for every line whose map special is nonzero, after each op (W1/S1 lines read 0 once cleared)
row_formats.MM: MM,case,op,id,kind,sector,entries: a mover just created by an EV_* body (kind 5 door, 6 plat, 7 floor) and the number of thinker-list entries of that sector at that moment, including a removed entry not yet unlinked (M3h8 note §2.1, §8)
row_formats.MP: MP,case,op,actor,movedir,numspechit: the P_Move failure branch with numspechit > 0, before movedir = DI_NODIR and the reverse P_UseSpecialLine loop
row_formats.MQ: MQ,case,op,slot,id: a nonnull activeplats slot after the op (id = sector-thinker store index)
row_formats.MT: MT,case,op,thing,code,z,height,radius,nofit: PIT_ChangeSector outcome after the clip: 0 fits, 1 health <= 0 -> S_GIBS (height and radius 0), 2 MF_DROPPED removed, 3 not shootable left as is, 4 nofit = true
row_formats.MU: MU,case,op,thing,line,side,special before,result,special after: P_UseSpecialLine (from PTR_UseTraverse or the P_Move failure branch)
row_formats.MV: MV,case,op,sector,plane,direction,speed,dest,before,after,result: T_MovePlane (plane 0 floor, 1 ceiling; result 0 ok, 1 crushed, 2 pastdest; heights raw)
row_formats.MW: MW,case,op,line,toptexture,midtexture,bottomtexture: the front side textures of a special line when one is nonzero (declared switch texture numbers); presentation
row_formats.MX: MX,case,op,thing,line,side,special: P_CrossSpecialLine entry from the P_TryMove crossing loop (side = the old side)
row_formats.MY: MY,case,op,thing,line,special: P_CrossSpecialLine exit (0 once a W1 line is cleared)
row_formats.MZ: MZ,case,op,usedown,playerstate,gameaction,secretexit,cmd.buttons of players[0] after each op (gameaction 6 = ga_completed)
row_formats.SD: SD,case,op,id: P_RemoveThinker marks sector thinker id (the E code 2 row stays for actors)
row_formats.SF: SF,case,op,id: P_RunThinkers unlinks sector thinker id and calls Z_Free (the harness quarantines it; ids are never reused)
row_formats.SO: SO,case,op,kind,index,sound: S_StartSound with a sector origin (kind 1: &sectors[index].soundorg) or with the address of buttonlist[index].soundorg (kind 2: P_UpdateSpecials passes the address of the field); a NULL origin (global) or a mobj origin keeps the inherited E,case,op,7,actor|-1,sound row
row_formats.TK: as M3h7, plus kind 5 door: id,sector,type,direction,topheight,topcountdown,speed,topwait; kind 6 plat: id,sector,type,status,count,low,high,speed,wait,crush,tag,oldstatus; kind 7 floor: id,sector,type,direction,floordestheight,speed,crush,newspecial,texture; kind 8: id, a sector thinker removed by P_RemoveThinker and not yet unlinked. Mover allocations are zero-filled (declared adapter), so never-written fields print 0

sanitizer_comparison.rule: --overflow-check rebuilds without -fwrapv under -fsanitize=signed-integer-overflow,integer-divide-by-zero,float-cast-overflow and --address-check under -fsanitize=address,undefined (both -fno-sanitize-recover=all); each run asserts its raw trace equals the strict trace byte for byte, so raw_trace_sha256 is the digest of all three
